en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey hotel building in a landscaped setting. The architecture has a late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century style with gabled roofs, many windows, and a long glazed veranda or winter garden along the ground floor. Beneath the image, centered text reads "Hotel Berg en Dal." The lower half of the card is blank except for a small handwritten note in the bottom left corner.
